content.title: The Only 3 Investments You Need to Build Real Wealth
content.text: ➡️ Apply for my 1:1 mentorship program (If you have more than $100K+ sitting in a low-interest bank and want to invest): https://bit.ly/3OA98gY ➡️ Apply for my 1:1 mentorship program (If you have more than $100K+ sitting in a low-interest bank and want to invest): https://bit.ly/48XkN0M ➡️ Join my FREE Beginner's Investing Class to reach your first $100K: https://bit.ly/3zUS9hI ➡️ FREE "Financial Freedom Faster" eBook & Money Cheat Sheet: https://bit.ly/3W1ecec When I first started investing, I was drowning in conflicting advice… silver, crypto, random ETFs, “hot” stocks—you name it. What finally changed everything for me was realizing I only needed three types of investments to actually grow my money. In this video, I’m walking you through the exact protection, growth, and income investments I use in my own portfolio today—money market funds for stability, simple ETFs + a few reliable companies for long-term growth, and dividend ETFs + covered calls for extra cash flow.
